name: Ogata Rina
source: A top singer -- a senior compared to Yuki. She reached this level through talent and hard work since her early childhood. She is beautiful, has a clear mind, elegant, hard worker, practice everyday and remains calm in front of any challenge. A young lady who has everything but at the expense of her time: her childhood, her student life...
